g.text: J1 is reserved for a future host. No mainboard connection in this revision.

g.desc: J1 is reserved for a future host. No mainboard connection in this revision.

g.text: Supply regulated 3.3 V at J1 or TP1/TP2 for bench testing.

g.desc: Supply regulated 3.3 V at J1 or TP1/TP2 for bench testing.

g.text: Do not apply battery voltage to the 3.3 V rail.

g.desc: Do not apply battery voltage to the 3.3 V rail.

g.text: SW2..SW5 -> U2 P0..P3, active low. Debounce in firmware.

g.desc: SW2..SW5 -> U2 P0..P3, active low. Debounce in firmware.

g.text: SW1 POWER -> J1.11; R14 10k pull-up to +3V3.

g.desc: SW1 POWER -> J1.11; R14 10k pull-up to +3V3.

g.text: Released HIGH, pressed LOW; independent of U1/U2.

g.desc: Released HIGH, pressed LOW; independent of U1/U2.

g.text: J1.7..10 are NC. TP8..11 are local debug pads only.

g.desc: J1.7..10 are NC. TP8..11 are local debug pads only.

g.text: Enable wheel: register 0x0E = 0xC0. Disable unused KEY3..11.

g.desc: Enable wheel: register 0x0E = 0xC0. Disable unused KEY3..11.

g.text: Firmware configuration and final-cover calibration are required.

g.desc: Firmware configuration and final-cover calibration are required.

g.text: Electrode shape includes switch clearances; verify 360-degree tracking.

g.desc: Electrode shape includes switch clearances; verify 360-degree tracking.

g.text: U2 P4..P7 share R13 pull-down. Keep 0x03 = 0xFF (all inputs).

g.desc: U2 P4..P7 share R13 pull-down. Keep 0x03 = 0xFF (all inputs).

g.text: INT_N is wired-OR: read BOTH devices until interrupt releases.

g.desc: INT_N is wired-OR: read BOTH devices until interrupt releases.

g.text: RESET_N resets both ICs; reinitialize both after reset.

g.desc: RESET_N resets both ICs; reinitialize both after reset.
